issue: Confirmed NOT a duplicate of T100001048176 (Sheikh Sabah LNG Terminal), despite the shared 'Sheikh Sabah' name/OtherNames overlap. Independent reporting (LNG Prime, Offshore Energy, MEES, Riviera, OGJ, Natural Gas World) consistently distinguishes: (1) this record = the sequence of interim CHARTERED FSRUs (Golar/Energos Eskimo 2015-2025 -> Energos Force 2025-2026 -> Excelerate Acadia from mid-2026) serving Aqaba on short-term leases; (2) T100001048176 = the PERMANENT onshore regasification unit + BW LNG-chartered FSU under construction, targeted for service Sept/Q3-Q4 2026, which will supersede this FSRU record. Two separate physical facilities at the same port, correctly modeled as two TerminalIDs.
suggested_action: No merge needed. Consider adding 'Sheikh Sabah' disambiguation note to both records' OtherNames/ResearcherNotes if not already clear enough for future researchers (both already carry 'Sheikh Sabah...' OtherNames, which is the source of the apparent collision).

issue: The task brief's 'orphan StartDate [ref]' flag for this row appears to be a false positive. Per docs/reference/gem_db_schema.md, StartDate [ref] is the single shared ref column for OriginalPlannedStartYear, LatestPlannedStartYear, AND ActualStartYear (there is no separate [ref] column for the two Planned* fields). This row has OriginalPlannedStartYear=2026 and LatestPlannedStartYear=2026 populated, so the existing StartDate [ref] (prnewswire) is legitimately paired, just not to ActualStartYear (which is blank because the terminal hasn't started yet).
suggested_action: No fix needed on this row; consider updating whatever completeness-sweep logic flags 'orphan StartDate [ref]' to check OriginalPlannedStartYear/LatestPlannedStartYear as valid pairings, not just ActualStartYear.
